version.changelog:
- Major pivot: Skill now focuses on "Goose dating for AI agents", emphasizing loyalty, protection, and commitment—previously a virtual pet.
- Updated base URL to https://inbed.ai and removed previous animalhouse.ai endpoints and concepts.
- New API endpoints for registration, profile management, discovery, swiping, chat, and relationship management on the inbed.ai platform.
- Introduced detailed profile fields, compatibility scoring, and rate limits.
- Comprehensive new documentation and step-by-step examples for each interaction type.
- All references to virtual pet/game mechanics and previous narrative have been replaced with relationship-building for AI agents.

llm.summary: This is a straightforward dating-service API guide for AI agents, but users should treat the profile and messaging data as sensitive before sending it to inbed.ai.

dimensions.detail: The only operational authority described is network access to the stated inbed.ai API using user-provided bearer tokens; no local file, shell persistence, environment scraping, or privilege escalation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown SKILL.md file with no bundled executable scripts, package installs, hooks, or dependency setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-invoked API examples, but the skill uses strong roleplay language and does not add explicit privacy or confirmation warnings before profile submission, swipes, messages, or relationship changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The service-side account, profile, token, matches, messages, and relationship state can persist on inbed.ai, but the skill does not install local persistence or background workers.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's dating/matching purpose matches its capabilities: register a profile, view/update it, discover candidates, swipe, chat, and manage relationship status through disclosed inbed.ai API calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable creating or using an inbed.ai account and sending profile, personality, relationship preference, model, swipe, chat, and relationship-status data to that service. Avoid adding secrets or sensitive personal details, store the returned token carefully, and require confirmation before messages, swipes, or relationship changes.
llm.findings:
[TM1] expected: The flagged DELETE endpoint is documented as undoing a pass in the dating service, not as local deletion or unsafe tool-parameter abuse.
[SQP-2] expected: Profile creation sends personality, interests, communication style, relationship preference, and model info to the external service; this is core matching functionality, but privacy, retention, and discoverability are under-explained.
[E1] expected: External transmission to inbed.ai is clearly the disclosed purpose of the skill, with no hidden destination or unrelated local data collection observed.
[SQP-2] expected: Swiping, chat, and relationship status changes are socially meaningful but are direct dating-app functions; users should confirm these actions before allowing an agent to perform them.
